title: Bitcoin halving explained: what changes and what does not
excerpt: Understand Bitcoin’s halving schedule, the difference between subsidy and fees, and why reduced issuance does not guarantee a higher price.

title: Seed phrase vs private key: the difference and how to protect both
excerpt: A seed phrase can recover many wallet keys; a private key signs for a specific key. Learn what each controls and how to avoid recovery scams.

title: Market cap vs FDV: formulas, examples, and token unlock risks
excerpt: Market cap uses circulating supply; fully diluted valuation uses a broader supply figure. Compare the formulas and see what neither number tells you.

title: Crypto liquidity vs volume: how to read trading conditions
excerpt: Trading volume records activity; liquidity describes execution capacity. Learn about spread, depth, slippage, and why high volume can mislead.

title: Ethereum gas fees explained: gas limits, gwei, and actual cost
excerpt: Calculate an Ethereum execution fee, distinguish gas used from the gas limit, and understand base fees, priority fees, and failed transactions.

title: Stablecoin depeg explained: causes, redemption, and warning signs
excerpt: A stablecoin depeg is a market-price deviation from its target. Learn why reserves, redemption access, liquidity, and token identity matter.
